title: Create forward force from a settled start.
brief: The seated forward takeoff is the priority: remove a standing countermovement and coordinate a direct leg push with the arms. The other jobs separate static extension, hip-led release, staggered ankle contact, hip impulse from a parked implement and force from a fixed split position.

explosive.name: Seated Broad Jump
explosive.job: Project forward from a supported motionless start.
explosive.cue: Sit near the edge, feet flat under or slightly ahead of knees; pause 2 s, swing the arms and jump forward to a two-foot 2 s hold.
explosive.regress: Reduce distance and choose a seat height allowing feet flat; stop if rocking or loss of landing replaces the task.

explosive.name: Squat Jump
explosive.job: Supply rapid leg extension from stillness without the forward-landing demand of the main drill.
explosive.cue: Hold a comfortable partial squat 2 s with hands on hips; jump upward without a new dip and stick on two feet.
explosive.regress: Use a shallower comfortable start and modest height; stop on a re-dip or unstable landing.

explosive.name: Tall-Kneeling Forward Medicine Ball Scoop Toss
explosive.job: Isolate hip-to-arm forward acceleration while removing ankle/knee takeoff.
explosive.cue: Kneel tall on a comfortable stable surface, ball low; hinge slightly at the hips then extend and scoop forward, keeping knees down and ribs controlled.
explosive.regress: Use a lighter ball and smaller hinge; no throw if kneeling is uncomfortable or containment is unverified.
explosive.intent: Fast release with a light ball; retain the prescribed grounded support

explosive.name: Split-Stance Pogo
explosive.job: Organize quick ankle pressure through a staggered base before split-position force work.
explosive.cue: Keep the chosen staggered stance unchanged; make small two-foot rebounds in place, then settle. Change lead foot for the other bout.
explosive.regress: Reduce amplitude; stop if feet scissor or contacts become deep knee bends.
explosive.intent: Small quick rebounds, not maximum height

explosive.name: Dead-Stop Kettlebell Swing
explosive.job: Produce a discrete hip impulse from a parked load rather than reuse successive swing momentum.
explosive.cue: Hike a light bell, snap the hips to float it below chest height, then guide it back to the floor and fully reset; one hike/swing/park is one rep.
explosive.regress: Use a lighter bell; stop for lumbar extension, arm lifting or loss of safe parking.
explosive.intent: Crisp hip-driven acceleration; feet stay planted and the bell stays controlled
explosive.gate: Familiar hinge/swing and secure two-hand handling.

explosive.name: Static Split-Squat Jump to Same-Stance Landing
explosive.job: Express rapid force from a fixed asymmetrical base without a midair leg switch.
explosive.cue: Pause 2 s in a shallow split squat, jump a small amount up/forward, land in the same split stance and hold 2 s.
explosive.regress: Reduce depth/travel; stop if the stance narrows, knee collapses or landing cannot be held.

control.name: Split Squat Isometric Hold
control.job: Lightly stabilize the knee/pelvis in the settled push position.
control.cue: Hold a shallow split stance with whole front foot down, rear heel lifted and pelvis level.
control.regress: Use a higher position; stop if it becomes a strain or knee control is lost.
control.intent: Bodyweight/light resistance, easy control; at least 5 clean reps in reserve or comparable ease

control.name: Calf Isometric Hold — Straight-Knee
control.job: Maintain controlled forefoot force with knees nearly straight at the end of the push.
control.cue: Both feet supported, rise modestly onto the forefeet and hold without ankle rolling; light hand support may steady the body.
control.regress: Lower heel height or effort; stop on cramp or shaking.
control.intent: Bodyweight/light resistance, easy control; at least 5 clean reps in reserve or comparable ease

strength.name: Hip Thrust — pelvic dumbbell, upper back on bench
Bent-Knee Soleus Raise — seated, dumbbells on thighs

decision: The repeated standing jump anchor was removed under the new uniqueness rule. Seated horizontal projection receives six attempts; the small vertical static jump is only a leg-extension support dose, not another distance test. Parked swings differ from Class 1's continuous-swing replacement by requiring a fresh impulse each rep. Soleus working volume is reduced from two sets to one because the class adds staggered rebound exposure; other strength doses are held without assumed performance.
next_job: Class 3 will address each leg's forward propulsion and controlled single-leg force acceptance; verify actual single-support competence first.
